parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units FROM (SELECT activities.molregno, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units FROM activities JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id WHERE assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054504' AND activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND activities.standard_relation = '=') AS act JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno ORDER BY cs.canonical_smiles ASC, md.chembl_id ASC, act.standard_type ASC, act.standard_relation ASC, act.standard_value ASC, act.standard_units ASC
